subject: math
description: Find the area left after removing circular parts from rectangles, squares, and larger circles by showing clear subtraction steps.
learningObjectives: Identify the whole region and the circular part or parts being removed
Find the area of rectangles, squares, circles, semicircles, and quarter circles
Use 3.14 or a given value of pi to estimate circle area
Subtract removed circular area from the whole area to find shaded area
Show subtraction steps clearly with correct square units
Check whether an answer is reasonable by comparing removed area with the whole
